original.target_description: Experiment 1, literal interpretation of implausible sentences, mixed-effects logistic regression with participant and item slopes/intercepts. Page 8054 contains both major-versus-minor edit change and insertion-versus-deletion tests; the neutral description and page locator do not identify which coefficient is intended.

n.sample_role: Participants contributing to the target mixed-effects model; exact final analytic participant count unresolved. Recruitment counts are not analytic N; item/trial counts are not participant N.
n.exclusions: Only self-identified native English speakers from the United States and participants answering at least 75% of plausible materials correctly were analyzed; zero to three participants excluded per experiment, without exact final counts for experiment 1 subexperiments.

notes: Identity assessment: canonical text is the primary six-page PNAS article, Rational integration of noisy evidence and prior semantic expectations in sentence interpretation, by Edward Gibson, Leon Bergen, and Steven T. Piantadosi; article footer identifies DOI 10.1073/pnas.1216438110, volume 110, issue 20, pp. 8051–8056 (2013), matching the supplied reference. Source URL header identifies the authors’ hosted PDF. Full article text includes Results, Methods and references; no PDF was supplied for layout rendering. Only n_o and es_value_o are assigned; all other fields/sides are placeholders. Target ambiguity: experiment 1 has major-versus-minor change β = 3.37, P < 0.0001, and insertion-versus-deletion β = 1.39, P < 0.0001. These are printed logistic-regression coefficients (β); no effect conversion or standardisation assertion is made. Neither is selected from the broad description/page locator. Methods describe experiments 1-1 through 1-5 as separate construction experiments. The stated 60 initial participants per experiment and 300 participants for experiment 1 are recruitment counts; zero to three exclusions per experiment do not establish exact final model N. No analytic N arithmetic is performed. No replication primary source is assigned or inspected.
